column3: Saori Route · It's Too Weird
Hmm...
Kyousuke-shi, what seems to be worrying you?
It's not a worry... how do I put it...
Honestly, I can't follow her at all.
But, is it really a good idea to clarify things?
No, A wise man keeps away from danger. I'll keep an eye out for her reaction.
Anyway
I'm really glad that you feel that way, yeah, but...
Are you indeed?!
If you find it acceptable, then I too shall rejoice!
Wait! I haven't agreed to it yet, right?
Having said all that, I understood something.
Saori's actions were too mysterious...
What is this! Suddenly wanting me to take these otaku goods... right?
Well then, what should I do?
Looks like it's impossible to persuade her in her current condition...
Err, well... I don't know what I should say, but...
But?
I have one thing to say!
Impossible! Something that's impossible is impossible!!
Wha-!? Kyousuke-shi!!?
Huff, huff, huff...
She couldn't follow me so far...!
Kyou-su-ke-shi-
AAHHHHH!?
Where did you come from! Are you a monster?!
Hmph... did you underestimate the probability of a chance encounter with me?
Are you a monster? Like monsters that pop up in an RPG?
Now now, let's leave the joke there...
...You still want me to take it after all?
That's precisely correct!
Please! I cannot entrust this matter to anyone but you!
Hmm...
But, you know...
But if it's really that important, you shouldn't just get rid of it.
I'd understand if you didn't need it anymore, but your collection is like your life, right?
There's no reason for you to give it to me.
If you could just accept this collection as if it were myself and treat it with great care...
Yes, think of it as me, greet it everyday, take baths together everyday...
There'd be plenty of problems with that too!
Hahaha, on the contrary, I'd welcome that!
Even if it's just a joke, pick something less questionable! Your jokes stink of an old man's sexual harassment.
Anyway! There wouldn't be any problems if you just accepted it!
Here, here, take it already!
It's not like it's Echigoya's golden candy, why would I take such a thing!
Take-it-please!
I don't NEED it!
Ah------ Why-----! Milord is being unreasonable!
H-Hey! Don't make weird noises in public!
Tch...We're not making any progress with this argument.
Now that it's come to this...!
Wow, where did that life-size Gundam came from?
What!? Where? Where is it?
Now or never!
Come back again master☆
D-Darn it! A ruse just now!
Kyousuke-shi! Wait for me!
Huff, huff, huff...
Fleeing this far, even Saori won't be able to chase after me.
Oh well, she doesn't look like the athletic type.
You can't sell wholesale to a wholesaler, Kyousuke-shi!
Sa-Saori!?
Where did you even come from!?
That is a trade secret①.
With her index finger pressing against her lips, she grinned at me.
That gesture's moe even when a girl wearing huge swirly glasses does it.
Kyousuke-shi, you cannot take it no matter what?
As I've said, isn't it supposed to be important stuff for you?
And why did you have to pick me? Couldn't it have been Kirino or Kuroneko?
I gave Kiririn-shi a figure out of goodwill in the past, and she ended up adding decorations to it...
Sadly, I am afraid the same thing might happen again...
As for Kuroneko-shi, she says there's no space in her room to store it.
I see...
That's why, I intend on having you accept it no matter what.
Hmm....
Okay. If you're going this far, I'll take it.
R-Really?!
Yes. However, I have a condition.
Since this is your stuff, I'll only holding onto it for you. When you need it back, you can come get it any time.
B-Blissful gratitude!
Yeah, I'll accept your passion and soul.
Haha! I am indebted to you!
Ah...
I haven't paid my share for the maid cafe...!
I took care of it for you, so rest assured.
Really? Sorry about that.
Is this much enough?
It's all right. You helped me a lot today, so don't worry about the money.
In return, please take good care of the goods.
Alright, I got it.
Well then Kyousuke-shi, see you.
